skos:Concept.skos:definition: Phylum Chordata. Class Mammalia. Order Chiroptera. Bats forelimbs form wedded wings with long spread-out digits covered by a thin membrane flapped in flying making them the only mammals capable of sustained flight. Bats have a highly adapted lung system, use echolocation as they have poorly developed eyes and most are nocturnal
